Markdown Content:
## Subscribe to Food Safety News

Get the free version of our newsletter. No spam ever, unsubscribe anytime.

September is National Food Safety Education Month. Most of what gets said about it concerns thermometers and washing your hands, and that is worth saying. What it leaves out is the year-round work of a few dozen organizations on the other end of the problem: the rules, the inspections, the research and the lawsuits that decide whether food is safe before it reaches a kitchen. With the largest Cyclospora outbreak in American history still being counted, this is the month to name them, one at a time. Today, the 30 that work the acute side, the pathogens. Tomorrow, the 10 that work the other half of the problem, the salt, sugar, fat and ultra-processed food that fill the same grocery cart, and 10 things all forty could do together. None has a client in this outbreak. None bills an hour for the work. Most are a handful of people and a mailing list.

**Eleven groups asked Congress to fix traceability last month**

On Aug. 12 the Safe Food Coalition sent [a letter to the four congressional leaders](https://consumerfed.org/media/ocvbm4dp/safe-food-coalition-letter-to-congressional-leaders-re-traceability-8-12-26-920.pdf?ref=foodsafetynews.com) asking them to rescind the rider that bars FDA from spending a dollar on its own traceability rule before 2028. [I wrote about it the next day](https://www.marlerblog.com/case-news/eleven-consumer-public-health-and-labor-groups-just-asked-congress-to-rescind-the-traceability-rider-they-are-right-and-section-780-is-worse-than-a-delay-because-it-also-t

title: Indonesia urged to act to stop meal program poisonings
summary:
Title: Indonesia urged to act to stop meal program poisonings

URL Source: https://www.foodsafetynews.com/2026/09/indonesia-urged-to-act-to-stop-meal-program-poisonings/

Published Time: 2026-09-07T04:03:08.000Z

Markdown Content:
More than 43,000 children have been affected

![Image 1: Indonesia urged to act to stop meal program poisonings](https://storage.ghost.io/c/43/4e/434e508a-5e2f-4102-a53d-00bca10bb4bf/content/images/size/w30/2026/09/dreamstime_foodborne-illness-infection-disease.jpg)

Published:September 07, 2026, 12:03 am

Last updated:September 08, 2026, 4:07 pm

The Indonesian Government has been urged to stop its case-by-case approach to poisoning incidents connected to the school meals program.

The MBG Watch Coalition said the government should declare an official food poisoning outbreak or a food safety emergency.

In January 2025, the government launched a Free Nutritious Meal (MBG) program to improve nutrition and health for millions of people. However, the plan has been blighted by illness reports among schoolchildren.

According to the coalition, more than 43,000 children have been affected in 20 months, meaning it is no longer a series of local incidents but a national cross-sectorial food safety emergency.
